name: qrcodegen
license_file: vendor/src/qrcodegen/c/qrcodegen.h (MIT license header); also c/qrcodegen.c, c/Makefile and Readme.markdown; the repo has no standalone LICENSE/COPYING file at v1.8.0
build_command: clang -std=c99 -O2 -Wall -fPIC -c vendor/src/qrcodegen/c/qrcodegen.c -o vendor/build/qrcodegen-clang/qrcodegen.o && ar rcs vendor/build/qrcodegen-clang/libqrcodegen.a vendor/build/qrcodegen-clang/qrcodegen.o && clang -std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L -D_GNU_SOURCE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pthread -Ivendor/src/qrcodegen/c vendor/build/qrcodegen-clang/probe.c vendor/build/qrcodegen-clang/libqrcodegen.a -o vendor/build/qrcodegen-clang/probe
probe_log_tail:
ok: version 5 LOW encode succeeds with size 37
ok: ECC LOW and HIGH yield different matrices at version 5
ok: repeated version 5 HIGH encode is deterministic
probe_result: READY (0 failure(s))
probe exit: 0
notes: Only the C library file c/qrcodegen.c is compiled (upstream qrcodegen-demo.c/qrcodegen-test.c excluded); upstream recommended flags -std=c99 -O preserved (-O2 -Wall). Probe pins minVersion=maxVersion to make the requested version explicit: version 1 / ECC MEDIUM / mask AUTO / no boost for 'HELLO WORLD' yields size 21 = 4*1+17, and version 5 / ECC HIGH for 'HELLO WORLD 12345' yields size 37 = 4*5+17; all three 7x7 finder patterns plus their light separators are verified module-by-module via qrcodegen_getModule at both versions. Requested ECC level is honored: LOW vs HIGH at the same pinned version and text produce different matrices with the same dimensions, and repeated encodes are byte-identical. No upstream source was modified.
